notes.title: EasySave Backup Update 1.32
notes.content:
With EasySave Backup version 1.32 it is now possible to have even more control over your saves. Using advanced recovery you can choose which files to restore, overwrite or even delete.

Thanks to the built-in presets it is possible to cleanly restore an old backup, automatically deleting any unnecessary save files, also using the delete save preset you will get the total removal of the current game save.
Useful if you want to restart the game from the beginning, but the game does not offer such a feature.

The second addition in the update is the introduction of Cloud Override, a system to force the game platform to synchronize the restored save (or the absence of the save) to the cloud, in order to prevent the old save from being re-downloaded from the cloud.
Thanks to Cloud Override it will no longer be necessary to deactivate the cloud function in the game platform to delete the save or restore an old one with fewer files.

notes.title: Update 1.31
notes.content:
EasySave Backup version 1.31 adds compatibility with the GameSave Manager database.

If you don't feel like adding definitions yourself, you can now access the large pool of definitions available in GameSave Manager. To do this, place the GameSave Manager "games.db" file in the EasySave Backup main folder, and select "import" in the EasySave Backup database section after have selected the game you are interested in importing the definitions.
The "games.db" file can be taken from a GameSave Manager installation or downloaded from the program's website.

Important notice :
EasySave Backup is in no way affiliated with GameSave Manager. Compatibility between the two systems is offered only as an additional option. The correct functioning of the definitions present in GameSave Manager cannot therefore be guaranteed.
For the same reason EasySave Backup has no right to include or redistribute the "games.db" file, which must necessarily be taken from the official source.


1.31 full changelog

- Added an import function from GameSave Manager database.
- Fixed custom file limit not activating the save button when changed.
- Fixed a rare and nasty bug occuring when only installed games are showed.
- Fixed a regression with locked backups caused by the addition of backup types.
- Fixed a bug when renaming a locked backup.
- Removed hardfix for Grand Theft Auto.

notes.title: Update 1.30
notes.content:
Snapshots... snapshot? Snapshot !

With EasySave Backup 1.30 it is now possible to make quick backups using a combination of keys (hotkey), without having to exit the game.
This gives you the ability to create snapshots of your saves, or "restore points" of what the game have saved up to that moment whenever you want.
An hotkey has also been added to enable or disable a sound alert every time the game saves.

Keyboard shortcuts can be changed and globally enabled in the options page, or can be enabled / disabled for each individual game.

Other changes in version 1.30 concern the automatic discarding of duplicate backups (a backup will no longer be saved if identical to the previous one) and the addition of a color scheme editor.

Full changelog for version 1.30 :

- Added In-game backup snapshots.
- Added keyboard shortcuts to enable / disable test sound and perform quick backup in-game.
- Duplicated (useless) backups are now automatically discarded.
- Improved performance when checking for installed games.
- Changed latest and locked backup position in the database for more readability.
- Added more info in the backup list about the backup type.
- Added a color scheme editor
- ESBService : The monitor window can now be open and closed by double clicking the systray icon.
- ESBService : Reworked sound system.
- ESBService : Fixed a rare bug halting the internal timer when a wrong executable is falsely white-listed.
- ESBService : Fixed some minor GUI bugs.

notes.title: EasySave Backup update 1.22
notes.content:
Second QOL update for EasySave Backup.

Filtering is finally added to both the Database and backup pages. It's now possibile to show only the installed games and search for a specific entry.

Update 1.22 complete changelog :

- Fixed graphical bug occouring on the Scan page when resizing the application window.
- Fixed some minor graphical bug when viewing the savegame sources.
- Archived backups are now sorted keeping the newest on top.
- Added filters to search and/or display only installed games on both backup and database lists.
- Added some database information to the folder page.
- Squashed more bugs.

notes.title: EasySave Backup update 1.21
notes.content:
[h1]New in 1.21[/h1]

[b]Aliases[/b]

Some games came in different versions (64 or 32 bit, or different DirectX) and can be launched from multiple executable. Prior to the 1.21 update only one executable per game could be choosed.
With aliaes every game's executable can be linked to the game, allowing the Scan Mode to recognize it and EasySave Backup Service to perform the automatic backup.

[b]Scan Filters Managing[/b]

Scan filters now can be easily added, edited and removed by the user.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

1.21

- Added aliases
- Added scan mode filters management. Now is possible to add / remove user filters and check how effective they are.
- Now is possible to copy a set of Master definition to the Custom set of the same game.
- Now the scan window isn't cleared when changing pages, only when selecting a different game from the database.
- All of the Steam library folders are now automatically added the first time the application is started.
- Changed rendering method of defenitions in the database.
- Fixed import of definitions not working if a game was already in the database without definitions.
- Fixed a regression causing an error when aborting a scan.

notes.title: EasySave Backup 1.20 released
notes.content:
The registry update is now out of the beta and released to everyone.

EasySave Backup is now able to automatically backup and restore saves stored in the registry. Saves definitions can be added manually or using the Scan feature. To make things easier, registry keys and values are added and edited in the same way as files and folders.

As always, if you have questions, suggestions, requests or want to provide some feedback, feel free to write them at https://steamcommunity.com/app/1113740/discussions/2/

Here is the full changelog for v1.20

- Added support for Windows registry backups.
- Modified backup file structure to support registry entries.
- Modified internal browser to work with registry entries.
- Modified scan mode to scan the "SOFTWARE" subkeys of HKEY_CURRENT_USER and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hives.
- Added the "SOFTWARE" key of HKEY_CURRENT_USER and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hives to the ADD files section.
- Added an automatic conversion of WOW6432 subkey for 32 and 64 bit windows.
- Added a button to restart EasySave Backup with administration privileges.
- Optimized finalizing of scanned files. Now scan mode is faster.
- Fixed a minor issue selecting backups with the same index in the three different list.
- Fixed a fatal error on 32 bit Windows.
- Fixed a graphical regression in the backup view.
- Fixed some minor GUI issues.

notes.title: Registry Beta available
notes.content:
Hello.
The registry backup feature is finally ready and available in the beta branch. To opt-in to the beta, click with the right mouse button on "EasySave Backup" on your Steam Library, choose "properties" then go in the "BETA" tab and choose "public registry beta" from the drop down menu.

Why a beta ?
In order to add the registry backup feature i had to change lot of the old code (and add new, of course). I've did a lot of extensive testing to make sure nothing has broken down and everything works, but with various different system configuration available i can't really be 100% sure.

Beta exists for this purpose... let users with totally different hardware and software combination to test and discover slipped bugs or incompatibilities.
So i've decided to release the new version to all those who want to test the new features in preview, and keep the official release to a later date.

So feel free to opt-in and eventually report found bugs (or ask for new features or informations) on Steam's Discussion board @ https://steamcommunity.com/app/1113740/discussions/2/

One final note : New backups (1.20) are not compatible with old versions of EasySave Backup (1.11 or older). Remember it if you plan to opt-out and return to the stable release.

---

Changelog for v1.20 (Beta)

- Added support for Windows Registry backup.
- Modified backup file structure to support registry entries.
- Modified internal browser to work with registry entries.
- Modified scan mode to scan "SOFTWARE" subkeys of HKEY_CURRENT_USER and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hives.
- Added the "SOFTWARE" key of HKEY_CURRENT_USER and HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE hives to the ADD files section.
- Added an automatic conversion of WOW6432 subkey for 32 and 64 bit windows.
- Added a button to restart EasySave Backup with administration privileges.
- Optimized finalizing of scanned files. Now scan mode is faster.
- Fixed a minor issue selecting backups with the same index in the three different list.
- Fixed a fatal error on 32 bit Windows.
- Fixed a graphical regression in the backup view.  
- Fixed some minor GUI issues.

Notes :

- Because of internal differences in the backup file structure, new backups aren't compatible  with older versions of EasySave Backup. Older backup can be restored without issues.
- Windows 10 can prevent restore of backups in HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE. Usually HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE isn't used for storing save information, but some older game do it. If a restore fails with the "Error creating registry keys" message, give administration privileges to EasySave Backup, or use the "Restart as Admin" button in the options page.

notes.title: Easysave Backup update 1.11
notes.content:
Hello. Registry update is in the work, but there are some improvement i feel necessary to release as soon as possibile.

As always, if you have questions or requests feel free to ask for them in the forum.


News in 1.11

- Added an option to disable notifications.
- Added an automatic save fix for Grand Theft Auto (Classic and Steam version). 
- Added integration with Free Tools in EasySave Backup Service. 
- Added beta version support to ESBservice update routine.

Fixes :

- Fixed a minor graphical bug in the database page.
- Fixed inconsistency with the database when adding / removing folders
- Fixed inconsistency with the backup list when adding / removing games

Changes :

- Limits can now modified by typing with the keyboard.
- Changed behaviour of the latest backup. Now the latest backup is always saved, and optionally copied to the archive folder.
- Modified some of the options to reflect the above change.
- Old latest backups are now automatically moved to the archive folder when a new one is saved.
- When a game is selected in the backup or in the database page, the selection is now reflected in the other page.

notes.title: EasySave Backup version 1.1
notes.content:
EasySave Backup updated released.

Now with automatic backup each time the game saves.


New in 1.1 release :

- Added an option to enable / disable the master list.
- Added the ability to force a manual backup in EasyBackup Service.
- Added optional test sound when EasyBackup service detect a save and when a backup is performed.
- Added a setting to enable automatic backups everytime the game saves.

Other changes / info
